1. Ridge 2 Backpacking Tent - $199.20 (was $249.00), rated 4.6/5. A freestanding 3-season tent with two doors, two vestibules, 20D ripstop nylon, waterproof rating of 3000mm, and a weight of 1900g.
2. Canopy 2 Trail Tent - $151.20 (was $189.00), rated 4.5/5. A lightweight 3-season tent with a full-coverage fly, 20D ripstop polyester, waterproof rating of 2500mm, and a weight of 2000g.
3. Creek 2 Budget Tent - $103.20 (was $129.00), rated 3.9/5. An affordable 3-season fair-weather tent made of polyester with a waterproof rating of 1200mm and a weight of 2400g.

The Ridge 2 is the highest-rated option and sits right at your budget limit with upgraded materials and lower weight, while the Canopy 2 is a great mid-range choice. Let me know if you would like to check stock for a specific color or add one to your cart!
